profile.subtitleJa: イスラエル人の出発地として挙げられる古代地域
profile.summaryJa: エジプトは、ヨシュア記2:10でラハブがイスラエル人の出発元として語る地域です。彼女は、主が葦の海の水を干上がらせたことと、イスラエル人がエジプトを出たことを聞いたと述べます。
profile.identityNoteJa: ここではヨシュア記の古代地域・王国を指します。
profile.modernLocationJa: ナイル川流域を中心とする古代の地域・王国名です。現在のエジプトの国境や国家範囲をヨシュア記の用例へそのまま当てはめることはできません。
profile.historicalRoleJa: ヨシュア記では、イスラエル人の出発地・過去の出来事の舞台として回想される地域名です。
profile.locationNoteJa: 地図に点が表示される場合も、所在地を示す確定位置ではなく、従来資料に基づく参考位置です。

wikipedia.title: Egypt
wikipedia.noteJa: 記事の歴史節は現在のエジプト国家の地域における古代史を扱います。聖書中の古代エジプトと現代国家を同一とする根拠ではありません。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, whom you utterly destroyed.
This is the reason Joshua circumcised them: all the people who came out of Egypt, who were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness along the way, after they came out of Egypt.
For all the people who came out were circumcised; but all the people who were born in the wilderness along the way as they came out of Egypt had not been circumcised.

For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness until all the nation, even the men of war who came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice. The LORD swore to them that he wouldn’t let them see the land which the LORD swore to their fathers that he would give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
The LORD said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” Therefore the name of that place was called Gilgal to this day.
They said to him, “Your servants have come from a very far country because of the name of the LORD your God; for we have heard of his fame, all that he did in Egypt,

from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,
I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
“‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.

When they cried out to the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. You lived in the wilderness many days.
“Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve the LORD.

for it is the LORD our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.

They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
